title: TTS serverless worker output (tts-serverless/v1)
description: Result of one phrase job: 1–2 takes (each with exactly one of audio_b64/audio_url), GigaAM word timestamps/WER and execution-fact telemetry, including the executed voice_mode and (for cloning) the verified reference_hash.

audio_b64.description: Base64 WAV bytes for results within OUTPUT_INLINE_MAX_MB / OUTPUT_INLINE_BUDGET_MB.

audio_url.description: Presigned HTTP(S) URL for results uploaded to S3-compatible storage.

duration_seconds.description: Fact duration read from the take's WAV header — not the window length.

sample_rate.description: Fact sample rate from the take's header.

channels.description: Fact channel count from the take's header.

seed.description: Seed actually used by the engine for this take (null when the engine reports none).

words.description: Word timestamps from GigaAM-v3 (absolute ms from the take start), not from the TTS model. Empty when the aligner is disabled or word_timestamps=false.

start_ms.description: Word start in milliseconds from the take start.

end_ms.description: Word end in milliseconds from the take start; > start_ms.

accent.description: Optional stress mark from the aligner/dictionary data.

wer.description: GigaAM-v3 word error rate against the normalized phrase; null when the aligner is disabled.

telemetry.description: Execution-fact telemetry. Versions, hash, seconds and license come from the loaded engine/aligner and the pinned weight files on the volume; input fields are never substituted.

engine.description: TTS engine id of the executed image. This worker reports qwen3_tts (Chatterbox, if ever enabled, is a separate image/stand).

engine_version.description: Version of the loaded TTS engine/model, e.g. qwen3-tts-12hz-1.7b@2026-01.

aligner_version.description: Version of the aligner that actually ran, e.g. gigaam-v3@2026-04; null when aligner.enabled=false.

model_hash.description: Measured sha256 of the executed TTS weight file, prefixed with sha256:.

gpu_seconds.description: Measured wall-clock seconds of synthesis + alignment.

license.description: License identifier of the executed TTS weights, from the pinned manifest row (Apache-2.0 for Qwen3-TTS).

voice_mode.description: Voice mode the job actually executed (input.voice.mode fact). On the Base image only clone is executable; preset fails visibly before this telemetry exists.

reference_hash.description: Verified sha256 of the cloned voice reference (raw lowercase hex, same form as input.voice.reference.sha256 / media content_hash); null for preset mode.
